findings.title: Severe data leakage in refund amount
findings.statement: The refund_amount column exhibits severe data leakage, separating the target almost perfectly with an AUC value of 1.0.
findings.recommendation: Remove refund_amount from the feature set before training predictive models to avoid target leakage.

findings.title: Raw data quality improvements after cleaning
findings.statement: The overall data quality score improved from 79.7 out of 100 to 100.0 out of 100 after removing duplicates, imputing missing values, and dropping leaky or constant columns.
findings.recommendation: Use the cleaned dataset for downstream modeling tasks.

findings.title: Duplicate rows identified and removed
findings.statement: The raw dataset contained 12 exact duplicate rows, representing 2.91 percent of the total data, which were removed during cleaning.
findings.recommendation: Verify the data ingestion pipeline to prevent duplicate order generation.

findings.title: Missing values and hidden tokens in region and quantity
findings.statement: The region column had 10.68 percent missing values alongside 44 hidden-missing tokens, while quantity had 17.96 percent missing values with 74 hidden-missing tokens.
findings.recommendation: Retain the missing indicator flags created during cleaning to preserve information about missingness patterns.

findings.title: Extreme skewness and outliers in revenue
findings.statement: Revenue showed extreme right-skewness with a skew value of 19.21 and 76 IQR outliers in the raw data.
findings.recommendation: Monitor the winsorized revenue feature during modeling to manage the impact of extreme values.

findings.title: Strong correlation between unit price and revenue
findings.statement: In the cleaned dataset, unit_price and revenue exhibit a strong positive Pearson correlation coefficient of 0.81.
findings.recommendation: Evaluate multicollinearity if including both unit price and revenue in linear models.

findings.title: Target class distribution for churn
findings.statement: The target variable churned has a class balance of 75.24 percent for the 'no' class and 24.76 percent for the 'yes' class in the raw dataset.
findings.recommendation: Account for class imbalance using appropriate evaluation metrics or resampling techniques.

narrative.headline: Dataset cleaned and data leakage resolved for customer churn prediction.
narrative.executive_summary: The dataset quality score improved from 79.7 out of 100 to 100.0 out of 100 after cleaning. Critical data leakage in the refund_amount column was identified and removed, alongside 12 exact duplicate rows representing 2.91 percent of the data. Missing values and hidden-missing tokens were addressed in region and quantity, while extreme skewness in revenue was managed. The target variable churned currently has a class balance of 75.24 percent for the 'no' class and 24.76 percent for the 'yes' class.
next_steps: Verify model performance without the leaked refund_amount feature.
Handle the class imbalance of 75.24 percent 'no' and 24.76 percent 'yes' in the churned target variable.
Utilize the added missing indicator flags for region and quantity during feature engineering.
Train baseline classification models using the cleaned dataset of 400 rows.
